do.text: Tint a tile by what the item is about: green for money in.

dont.text: Don't pick a tone for looks: red reads as blocked or failed.

title: Name a tile that does something

do.text: Render a tile that opens something as a link (`render`), with its own name (`aria-label="Open settings"`).

dont.text: Don't name it after its glyph (“Icon”): say what it opens.
